kind: trade PLANNER (structure read + launch zones). NOT auto-trade, NOT an entry signal — the human confirms and decides.
entry_point: inference.plan(bars_by_tf, cell) -> None | {direction, continue, dir_confidence, erl_target, invalidation, zones[<=3]}
trigger: call plan() after every CLOSED path-TF bar; it returns a result only on the bar that confirms a new ERL break (else None).

input_contract.bars_by_tf: dict {timeframe: pandas DataFrame with columns open,high,low,close}
input_contract.index: each bar indexed by its OPEN timestamp
input_contract.timezone: UTC. Pass tz-naive UTC or tz-aware UTC; the model converts to America/New_York INTERNALLY for killzone features — do not pre-shift.
input_contract.bar_convention: a bar is usable only once CLOSED (open + timeframe_duration <= now); pass only closed bars.
input_contract.ordering: ascending by time, contiguous, no gaps/duplicates per timeframe.
input_contract.min_lookback: >= 12 months of continuous history per timeframe so the structure state (ERL/swings/zones) is warm; more history is fine and preferred.

stage1.scaler: ctx_mu/ctx_sd embedded in each .pt (apply (ctx-mu)/sd; never refit)

stage2.scaler: NONE — trees; do not scale the features

runtime: Python only (see requirements.txt). The feature/structure pipeline is vendored byte-identical under lib/ and MUST run natively — never re-implement it in another language (that is where model quality dies).
